clips.title: The story
paras: Beside his strange apparatus in Ratchet, Wrenix the Wretched helps crack tough locks. The goblin tinker offers tools to open secure caches.

Wrenix the Wretched works beside his machinery in Ratchet, the goblin port on the Barrens coast. As a tinker of the Steamwheedle Cartel, he knows mechanisms and contraptions, and how to bypass locks and salvage what lies beyond them. Rogues and scouts working the coast can turn to him for help.

Wrenix keeps his gizmotronic apparatus close at hand. He uses it and his mechanical skill to supply thieves' tools and lock-picking instruments. Those seeking to recover stolen Southsea pirate contraband along the Merchant Coast can put them to use.
